scope: Completed regular scalar-isoperimetric K3 and weak finite-piecewise K4, including nonautonomous and original-predicate endpoints.

runtime.compiler: Stock native Lean; no compiler, elaborator, kernel, or axiom modifications.
runtime.host_compatibility: A narrow startup shim resolves /proc/self/exe for the stock binary in this execution host.
runtime.validation_method: Pinned native compiler build of the entire default-library and regression dependency closure, not a literal lake build invocation.

build.reuse_rule: Reuse only previously successful native compiler objects with identical recursive source-closure fingerprints and the same pinned runtime and options.

axiom_audit.method: Lean.collectAxioms for every declaration owned by each scoped module, including private and generated declarations.

semantic_review.nature: Independent source-level semantic review, complementary to native kernel checking.
